text:
maria: Quick check — planning the release post + webinar for next Wed. Need eng to confirm changelog PR + docs anchors so marketing can lock final blog links and demo slides. Can we get this done in ~24h? :eyes:
ashwin: Can you drop the PR/commit and confirm the canary window you want? Also any special fallback note we should include?
maria: PR (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/commit/ab12c3 — changelog file at docs/changes/2026-03-24.md. Proposed canary: Wed 10:00–12:00 PST. Need docs anchors for 'model-routing' and 'dedicated-capacity' so blog links aren't 404.
jamal: I can add the anchors. Will push a patch to docs repo in ~3h. What exact anchor text do you want?
maria: Keep it short: use "Model routing & failover" and "Dedicated capacity overview" — marketing will match CTA copy to that.
ashwin: Also call out the canary fallback policy in the post (that requests fall back to smaller model variant if capacity constrained). Ops: @deploy-bot can you reserve the canary slot and tag infra?
deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved: 2026-03-24T10:00:00-08:00 to 2026-03-24T12:00:00-08:00. Canary tag: rc/2026-03-24-webinar. :white_check_mark:
taylor: Webinar speakers confirmed? Need at least one eng speaker for the Q&A — @ashwin available?
ashwin: I can take a 10min demo + Q&A. Need final deck by Tue EOD. If you want me to include a short run-through of failover behavior I can add a 2-slide sequence.
lisa: For inbound routing — will we have a distinct trial CTA for Dedicated customers? Marketing needs the docs link to populate the nurture form.
jamal: I will add a dedicated anchor at /docs/dedicated-trials and include the sample CTA snippet in the patch.
maria: OK locking timeline: docs patch + changelog merged by Tue 18:00 UTC, canary Wed 10–12 PST, public announce Wed 12:30 PST, webinar Thurs 17:00 UTC. Everyone good? :thumbsup:
ashwin: Good from eng. I'll merge changelog PR barring regressions. If something comes up we fallback to a reduced announce (embeddings-only).
maria: Perfect — I'll update the marketing calendar, send the pre-announce to partners, and drop final deck to @ashwin by Tue 16:00. If anyone needs to shift windows ping here.

# quick dev ops note (for engineers):
```
# merge changelog commit
git fetch origin
git checkout main
git cherry-pick ab12c3
git push origin main
```
